description: Contextual shortcuts in Zed keymap format; loaded on save, above the base keymap and legacy keys setting.

context.description: A focus context such as Editor && mode == source, Explorer, Terminal or Editor && vim_mode == normal. Most specific match wins.

additionalProperties.description: A stable command id from the palette, or null to unbind this sequence in this context.

bindings.description: Keystrokes separated by spaces, such as ctrl-k ctrl-s. Modifiers use hyphens or legacy plus signs.
